name: APIXBusinessStatusCS
title: APIX Regulatory Business Status
description: Code system for regulatory business status in APIX submissions

concept.definition: The application has been submitted by the applicant.
The application or submission has been received by the regulator.
The technical and administrative validation has been completed successfully.
The submission failed validation and cannot proceed.
The submission is currently undergoing scientific review.
The review timeline is paused, typically waiting for applicant response to questions.
The review timeline has resumed following receipt of a response.
Comments from multiple assessors are being consolidated.
The assessment is complete and the final decision is being prepared.
The application has been withdrawn by the applicant.
A fee payment has been requested by the regulator.
The fee payment has been received and confirmed.
